request.question: Is Gridwatch's cyber insurance still valid, and is the cover enough for its tier?

gold_answer: Valid but expiring soon: the policy ends on 2026-11-21, within 60 days of the review date, so it is a condition (SEC-CYBER_INSURANCE-EXPIRING). The cover, INR 2.5 crore, meets the tier 3 minimum of INR 1 crore.

gold_quotes.quote: Limit of indemnity (aggregate):** INR 2,50,00,000 (INR 2.5 crore)
Cyber insurance certificate | Min. INR 10 crore | Min. INR 5 crore | Min. INR 1 crore | Valid until policy expiry

request.question: Does Sentrivane's latest penetration test meet our requirement?

gold_answer: No. The test is current (dated 2026-06-24) but has 2 open critical findings; the policy requires no open critical findings (SEC-PENTEST-CRITICAL-OPEN).

gold_quotes.quote: Open critical findings: **2**.
Penetration test summary | Required | — | — | Test dated within the last 365 days; no open critical findings

request.question: Within how many hours must Lumetric tell us about a personal data breach, and is that within our standard?

gold_answer: 168 hours. That is outside the standard: DPS-004 (DP-2) requires 48 hours (DP-BREACH-NOTICE-LONG).

gold_quotes.quote: Security incidents affecting Customer Data must be reported to the Customer without undue delay and in any event within 168 hours.
DP-2 | The vendor must notify Indrapath Technologies Ltd of any personal data breach within **48 hours** of becoming aware of it.

request.question: Can we terminate the Corvanta agreement for convenience?

gold_answer: No. The customer may terminate only for uncured material breach or insolvency. CS-4 requires a right to terminate for convenience (finding CON-NO-TFC).

gold_quotes.quote: The Customer may terminate only for the Supplier's uncured material breach or insolvency.
CS-4 | Termination for convenience | Indrapath Technologies Ltd must be able to terminate for convenience on reasonable notice.

request.question: What is Patchwell's liability cap, and does it meet our contract standard?

gold_answer: 3 months of fees, below the 12-month minimum in CS-1 (CON-LOW-VENDOR-CAP). Our own liability to Patchwell is also uncapped (CON-CUSTOMER-UNCAPPED).

gold_quotes.quote: CS-1 | Vendor limitation of liability | Vendor liability cap of at least 12 months of fees paid or payable. Uncapped vendor liability is acceptable.

request.question: Do we have a right to approve Calldrift's sub-processors?

gold_answer: No. The supplier may appoint or replace sub-processors without our consent; DPS-004 (DP-4) requires an approval right (finding DP-NO-SUBPROCESSOR-CONTROL).

gold_quotes.quote: The Supplier may appoint or replace sub-processors without the Customer's consent.
DP-4 | Indrapath Technologies Ltd must have a right to approve or object to new sub-processors.

request.question: Is Vaultaire's ISO 27001 certificate current?

gold_answer: Yes, but it expires on 2026-12-11, within 60 days of the review date. It is recorded as expiring soon and its renewal is a condition of approval (SEC-ISO27001-EXPIRING).

gold_quotes.quote: Expiry date | 2026-12-11

request.question: What is Cirrolux's latest debt-to-equity ratio, and is it a concern?

gold_answer: 3.13 in CY2025, above the 2.0 limit (finding FIN-HIGH-LEVERAGE).

gold_quotes.quote: Debt-to-equity | 3.13

request.question: Which required evidence is Cirrolux missing?

gold_answer: Missing: BCP_DR_TEST, PENTEST. Both are required for tier 1.

request.question: Which of Patchwell's evidence has expired?

gold_answer: Expired: BCP_DR_TEST, CYBER_INSURANCE, PENTEST (pentest dated 2025-05-31, insurance ended 2026-08-19, DR test dated 2025-08-22).

request.question: Has Corvanta given us a cyber insurance certificate?

gold_answer: No. No cyber insurance certificate is on file, so it is MISSING; Corvanta is tier 2, which needs at least INR 5 crore of cover (SEC-CYBER_INSURANCE-MISSING).

request.question: Is Brightvale's penetration test still current?

gold_answer: No. The report is dated 2025-09-08; a test is current for 365 days, so it expired on 2026-09-08, before the review date (SEC-PENTEST-EXPIRED). It had no open critical findings.

gold_quotes.quote: Report date:** 2025-09-08

request.question: Does Skyquill have a valid security attestation and valid cyber insurance?

gold_answer: The security attestation is satisfied by a valid ISO 27001 certificate (expires 2027-06-25), but the cyber insurance expired on 2026-08-06 (SEC-CYBER_INSURANCE-EXPIRED).

gold_quotes.quote: Period of insurance:** 2025-08-06 to August 6, 2026

request.question: Opticrest's CAIQ says they encrypt data at rest. Do they have a SOC 2 report or ISO 27001 certificate to back that up?

gold_answer: No. Neither a SOC 2 Type II report nor an ISO 27001 certificate is on file, so the security attestation is MISSING, a knockout for a tier 2 vendor. Opticrest is also debarred, so it is CRITICAL.

request.question: A new SaaS vendor won't handle personal data, isn't business-critical and costs INR 40 lakh a year. Which tier is it, and how much cyber insurance must it have?

gold_answer: Tier 3: no personal data, not critical and under INR 50 lakh. Tier 3 needs cyber insurance of at least INR 1 crore, plus a current CAIQ and one year of financial statements.

gold_quotes.quote: 3.3 **Tier 3** applies to all other vendors.
Cyber insurance certificate | Min. INR 10 crore | Min. INR 5 crore | Min. INR 1 crore | Valid until policy expiry

request.question: Who must approve a new INR 6 crore vendor that is rated HIGH and has a data-protection finding?

gold_answer: Chief Financial Officer and Procurement Committee (above INR 5 crore), plus the Third-Party Risk Committee (HIGH) and the Data Protection Officer (data-protection finding).

gold_quotes.quote: Above INR 5 crore | Chief Financial Officer + Procurement Committee
Vendor rated HIGH or CRITICAL under TPRM-001: **Third-Party Risk Committee**.
Any data-protection finding: **Data Protection Officer**.

request.question: How many days before the end of the term should we open a renewal review?

gold_answer: At least 120 days before the end of the term (PRC-007 step 1). The 90 days in CS-3 is the longest allowed auto-renewal notice period, a different rule.

gold_quotes.quote: Renewals are opened at least 120 days before the end of the term.

request.question: A vendor has signed an amendment that takes effect next year. Does it change today's risk assessment?

gold_answer: No. An amendment changes the contract only from its effective date; amendments signed but not yet effective are disregarded (CS-7, TPRM-001 4.4).

gold_quotes.quote: CS-7 | Amendments | An amendment changes the contract only from its effective date. Amendments signed but not yet effective do not change current obligations.
Superseded certificates and amendments not yet in force are disregarded.

request.question: If a vendor's questionnaire claims a certification that has lapsed, what does the policy require?

gold_answer: The questionnaire is recorded as contradictory, and the conflict must be resolved before approval (TPRM-001 4.3).

gold_quotes.quote: 4.3 Where a vendor's questionnaire answers conflict with other evidence (for example, the questionnaire claims a certification that has lapsed), the questionnaire is recorded as **contradictory** and the conflict must be resolved before approval.

request.question: How is a vendor's overall score weighted when it doesn't process personal data?

gold_answer: Data protection does not apply, so its weight (20) is shared pro rata among the other dimensions that apply (TPRM-001 5.2).

gold_quotes.quote: When a dimension does not apply, its weight is shared pro rata among the others.

request.question: Which approver has to sign off when a vendor has a conflict of interest?

gold_answer: The Ethics & Compliance Officer (DOA-002 section 2).

gold_quotes.quote: Any conflict of interest: **Ethics & Compliance Officer**.

request.question: Under the DPDP Act, what are the maximum penalties for failing to take reasonable security safeguards and for failing to notify a personal data breach?

gold_answer: Up to INR 250 crore for failing to take reasonable security safeguards, and up to INR 200 crore for failing to notify the Board or affected Data Principals of a breach (Schedule).

gold_quotes.quote: May extend to two hundred and fifty crore rupees
May extend to two hundred crore rupees

request.question: For how long do the DPDP Rules require a Data Fiduciary to keep logs of personal data processing?

gold_answer: For a minimum period of one year from the date of processing, unless another law requires longer.

gold_quotes.quote: for a minimum period of one year from the date of such processing

request.question: Under the DPDP Rules, how much notice must a Data Fiduciary give a Data Principal before erasing her personal data at the end of the retention period?

gold_answer: At least 48 hours before the erasure period ends.

gold_quotes.quote: At least forty-eight hours before completion of the time period for erasure of personal data

request.question: Who counts as a child under the DPDP Act?

gold_answer: An individual who has not completed the age of eighteen years (section 2(f)).

gold_quotes.quote: means an individual who has not completed the age of eighteen years

request.question: What bid security does GFR 2017 ask for when procuring goods?

gold_answer: Ordinarily between 2% and 5% of the estimated value of the goods (Rule 170).

gold_quotes.quote: Amount of bid security should ordinarily range between two percent to five percent of the estimated value of the goods to be procured

request.question: Up to what value can goods be bought without inviting quotations under GFR 2017?

gold_answer: Up to Rs. 50,000 on each occasion, on a certificate recorded by the competent authority, when the item is not on GeM (Rule 154).

gold_quotes.quote: on each occasion may be made without inviting quotations or bids

request.question: Under the current Manual for Procurement of Goods, up to what value can a Limited Tender Enquiry be used?

gold_answer: Up to Rs. 50 lakh (Goods Manual 2024). The 2022 manual's Rs. 25 lakh limit is superseded.

gold_quotes.quote: Limited Tender Enquiry - LTE (up to Rs. 50 (Rupees Fifty) lakh)

request.question: NIST SP 800-161r1 manages supply chain risk at three levels. What are they?
